name: Circle Wipe
description: A circle grows from a point until the arriving scene fills the screen.

options.name: center_x
options.description: Where the circle grows from, across the screen: 0 is the left edge, 1 the right

options.name: center_y
options.description: Where the circle grows from, down the screen: 0 is the top edge, 1 the bottom

options.name: softness
options.description: The edge: 0 is hard, 1 as wide as the screen
